calendar.fit_permission: no fitted coefficient; every threshold frozen here
calendar.later_window_use: report-only; never select, rerank, invert, refit, or repair
calendar.window_assignment: UTC half-open windows; entry and scheduled exit both contained

causal_availability.already_aligned_rule: an available_at exactly on a 5m boundary still receives the additional 300-second complete-bar latency
causal_availability.feature_rows: t and strict-prior source rows only
causal_availability.missing_bucket_policy: reject source; never fill or backdate
causal_availability.retrieval_cutoff: rows whose frozen available_at or entry_time lies outside a split are omitted; never backfill or relax a window

controls.block_weight_only: require nonzero log_weight_7d/log_weight_24h with equal signs; use strict-prior rank of abs(log_weight_7d)>=0.75, fullness_rank>=0.50, and side=sign(log_weight_7d); build its own clock
controls.constant_long_same_clock: same primary entry/exit clock with side fixed long
controls.constant_short_same_clock: same primary entry/exit clock with side fixed short
controls.direction_flip: same primary clock and eligibility with every side multiplied by -1; diagnostic only
controls.impulse_only: require impulse_24h!=0, retain impulse_magnitude_rank>=0.75 and fullness_rank>=0.50 with side=sign(impulse_24h); remove seven-day transport; build its own chronological non-overlap clock
controls.low_fullness_complement: retain transport magnitude_rank>=0.75 and transport/impulse sign agreement but require fullness_rank<0.50; build its own clock
controls.month_side_stratified_random_clock: build a feature-agnostic rank-ready split-contained chronological non-overlap pool; within each split-month SHA256-order candidates by 20260720|window|month|entry_time, take the primary month total, assign the first primary-long count long and the remainder short
controls.one_bar_delayed_entry: same primary signals and sides; shift entry and scheduled exit exactly one complete 5m bar later; drop any shifted interval that is no longer split-contained
controls.serialized_size_only: require nonzero log_size_7d/log_size_24h with equal signs; use strict-prior rank of abs(log_size_7d)>=0.75, fullness_rank>=0.50, and side=sign(log_size_7d); build its own clock
controls.stale_7d: at source bucket t apply primary eligibility and side to the fully formed primary feature/ranks from t-14; retain t availability and execution clock
controls.transport_only: require transport_7d!=0, retain magnitude_rank>=0.75 and side=sign(transport_7d); remove impulse confirmation and fullness floor; build its own chronological non-overlap clock

eligibility.ordering: sort by entry_time then bucket_start; accept earliest eligible candidate when entry_time>=prior accepted exit_time; entry equal to prior exit is allowed; suppress intervening candidates with no score priority or replacement
eligibility.zero_tolerance: none; exact binary64 zero is invalid

execution.entry: open exactly at entry_time after the latency bar closes
execution.funding: exact funding, entry-inclusive/exit-exclusive, fixed entry quantity

normalization.window_selection: use exactly the most recent 180 strict-prior base-valid rows when available, otherwise all available; fewer than 120 makes the current row rank-unready

policy.promotion_boundary: snapshot research only; no live or shadow promotion before 90 forward shadow days pass frozen schema, freshness, revision, and value-stability checks

source_features.base_valid_feature_row: require t through t-14 present as 15 consecutive exact 12h buckets; avg_size and avg_weight finite and >0; every derived witness_share and current fullness finite and within [0,1]
source_features.numeric_contract: IEEE-754 binary64; math.log for component controls; no epsilon, clipping, rounding, interpolation, fill, or imputation; exact binary64 equality defines zero and rank ties
source_features.source_gap_action: reject entire support build before features

policy.stopping_rule: stop permanently at first support/train/test/eval/forward/stitched gate failure; no sign, threshold, rank-window, support-floor, hold, latency, calendar, or clock repair; no failed-policy inversion

strict_accounting.cagr_clock: full declared wall-clock window including idle cash
strict_accounting.cluster_test: one-sided weekly entry-cluster sign flip; 100000 draws; seed 20260720
strict_accounting.costs: entry, scheduled exit, and hypothetical adverse liquidation costs included
strict_accounting.held_path_order: all favorable OHLC/funding-credit extremes before all adverse OHLC/funding-debit extremes

support_gates.controls: report source-only incidence for every control; a control may challenge specificity only if it independently satisfies the same applicable support floors before its outcomes are opened
support_gates.count_basis: source-only accepted primary entries after eligibility, split containment, and chronological non-overlap
support_gates.month_share_basis: maximum calendar-month count divided by total window count; total entries, not side-specific entries
support_gates.support_failure_action: reject WCTR-288 without opening market/funding/outcomes; no repair

research_sequence.outcomes: train, test, eval, forward, then stitched full horizon; stop at first failure

causal_availability.earliest_entry_rule: first complete 5-minute execution bar after available_at
causal_availability.edge_policy: drop first and last response buckets
causal_availability.missing_bucket_policy: reject any gap; never forward-fill or backdate

raw_artifact.encoding: gzip of exact HTTP response bytes; mtime=0

source_audit.missing_bucket_policy: reject any gap; never forward-fill or backdate

source_semantics.avg_size: integer-cast average serialized block size among non-stale blocks in the 12-hour source bucket
source_semantics.avg_weight: integer-cast average BIP 141 block weight among the same non-stale blocks and source bucket
source_semantics.derived_features: none in the frozen source artifact
source_semantics.pairing: sizes and weights require exact avgHeight and timestamp identity before normalization
